input.change_text: Fix ReDoS vulnerability in UriTemplate regex patterns (CVE-2026-0621)

output.subject: CVE-2026-0621: ReDoS in @modelcontextprotocol/server UriTemplate regex
output.action_text: Upgrade `@modelcontextprotocol/server` to 2.0.0-alpha.1+ to patch CVE-2026-0621 (ReDoS in `UriTemplate` regex patterns). Pre-fix, an attacker-controlled URI matched against a vulnerable template could pin a CPU thread — DoS class, no RCE.
